description: List curated design references (non-rejected) with name, category, tags, fonts, palette, and source attribution. Never returns raw HTML. Use the id or slug with bamf.instantiate_design_reference. Pass platform (linkedin|x|instagram) and/or post_type to get the built-in brand-free default post references (category post_reference: aspect ratio, copy skeleton, do/don't notes); brand kits always win over them. include_guide=true also returns the official repurposing guide.

design_subtype.description: With source=library, e.g. numbered_cards, cheat_sheet, steps_process, whiteboard, dark.

design_type.description: With source=library, e.g. infographic, diagram, tweet_card, quote_card, personal_image, visual_metaphor.

post_type.description: e.g. text, image_quote, infographic, carousel, motion_infographic, single_post, thread, quote_card, screenshot, comic, feed_image, reel_cover

source.description: library = human-approved reference designs (reference image, design_type, design_subtype, slot shape, person slot, render route, agent_notes). Pick by subtype and slot shape that fit the post.

name: bamf.list_design_references
